9691.html:
9691 ma base of singular oblique cases of 1st person pronoun: acc. mā́m, inst. máyā, dat. máhyam, gen. máma, encl. mē.
    Pa. maṁ, mayā, mayhaṁ, mama; Aś. acc. maṁ, inst. mayā, gen. shah. man. maa, gir. kāl. dh. mama; NiDoc. gen. dat. mama, mahi; Pk. acc. maṁ, mamaṁ, inst. maē, gen. mama, majjhaṁ, Ap. inst. maï˜. — Except in some peripheral NIA. languages a form based for the most part on Pk. inst. maē (with substitution of nominal inst. ending -eṁ < -ēna) has taken the place of old nominative ahám; Gy. eur. me 'I', pal. ắma; Chil. Gau. Sv. Phal. Sh. ma (but Phal. inst. mē, mī), S.srk. mā̃, mū̃; L. maĩ, mε῀ nom. and inst., P. maĩ, WPah.jaun. mē̃ (nom. also hāũ, aũ); Garh. maĩ, mĩ (inst. maĩn), Ku. maĩ, mī (inst. maĩle), N. ma, emph. maĩ (inst. maile), A. maï, B. (vulgar) mui, Or. mu, mũ; OAw. maïṁ nom. and inst.; H. maĩ (inst. maĩne), OMarw. mẽ, M. mī˜, mī. — Other forms: Pr. əm gen.; Tir. masi 'to me'; Kho. ma acc. and gen.; Tor. Sv. mī gen.; K. mĕ dat. inst. abl.; S. encl. -mi 'of, to, by me' < mē, L. encl. -m; WPah.bhad. maĩ inst. (aũ nom.), G. mε῀; Si. mama nom.; — H. mujh obl.; OG. majha dat., M. maj̈ obl., māj̈hā 'my', Ko. majjo. — The genitive is replaced by a declinable adjective with various suffixes: Gaw. mōna, Tir. myāna, K. myônᵘ; — Gy. gr. minro, SEeur. moi̦ó m., mei̦í f., L. maĩḍā, maiḍā; — Ap. mahāriya-, mēra-, WP. mε῀rā, P. merā, WPah. jaun. Garh. Ku. N. mero, A. mohora, mora, Or. mohara, OAw. moraü, H. merā, OMarw. meraü, OG. māharaü, G. mārũ. — See ahám, māmaká-.
    MAṀH 'give': máhas-².
    Addenda: ma-: Kho. ma 'me' obl. BKhoT 70; WPah.kṭg. mũ 'I'; Md. ma 'I, me' (gen. ma-ge, dat. mařař).
    †mámat.
    †makkaṇa- see matkuṇa-².

988 asmā́ka 'ours' RV., āsmāká- VS. [asmad-]
